attributes.title: Desarrollador/a Full-Stack
attributes.description:
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional con PHP y Laravel.
  • Experiencia desarrollando frontends con Vue.js.
  • Buen manejo de SQL y modelamiento de bases de datos relacionales (MySQL o SQL Server).
  • Experiencia construyendo y consumiendo APIs REST.
  • Manejo de Git y trabajo con ramas y pull requests.
  • Buena comunicación y capacidad de trabajar en equipo.
  • Autonomía, proactividad y ganas de aprender.
attributes.functions:
Dentro de tus principales funciones estarán:

  • Desarrollar nuevos módulos y funcionalidades en nuestras plataformas Laravel + Vue, de punta a punta: modelo de datos, API, interfaz y despliegue.
  • Desarrollar y mantener servicios de datos en Python (FastAPI) desplegados en API Gateway AWS Lambda, que alimentan nuestras plataformas con información de clientes y evaluaciones.
  • Mantener y mejorar las plataformas existentes: corrección de errores, rendimiento y refactorización.
  • Integrar servicios externos (Servicio de Impuestos Internos, burós de crédito, bancos, CRM) y APIs internas.
  • Participar en revisiones de código (pull requests) y proponer mejoras técnicas y de arquitectura.
  • Colaborar con negocio y producto en la definición de requerimientos e interfaces.
  • Contribuir al logro de los objetivos y KPIs del equipo.

Nuestro stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8 / Laravel, Python / FastAPI, AdonisJS (Node.js + TypeScript).
  • Frontend: Vue.js, Inertia.js, Element UI / Element Plus, TailwindCSS, Vite.
  • Datos: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis.
  • Cloud: AWS (Lambda, S3, RDS, EC2, SNS), Cloudflare.
  • Herramientas: Git / GitHub, Sentry, Notion.
attributes.desirable:
Suma puntos si tienes:

  • Experiencia con Python (FastAPI, pandas o SQLAlchemy) y despliegues serverless en AWS Lambda.
  • Experiencia con Inertia.js o Vue 3.
  • Experiencia con Node.js / TypeScript, idealmente AdonisJS.
  • Experiencia con otros servicios de AWS (S3, RDS, SNS).
  • Experiencia escribiendo tests (PHPUnit / Pest) y usando herramientas de calidad de código.
  • Experiencia en factoring, fintech o integraciones con el SII.
  • Portafolio o repositorios públicos (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).

attributes.title: Web App Full-Stack Engineer
attributes.description:
Requirements

  • Senior-level engineer with 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong backend development experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing AI features.
  • Practical experience working with large language models (LLMs).
  • Practical experience with computer vision.
  • C1 English level or higher.
  • Hands-on experience with production web application development, AI feature development, Web APIs, software architecture, testing, and deployment.

We value sound technical judgment, independent execution, and the ability to solve complex engineering problems while delivering measurable product impact.
attributes.functions:
We are seeking a Senior Web App Full Stack Engineer to build and improve production web applications with a strong focus on backend systems and AI-powered capabilities. You will work across the stack, taking ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and iteration.

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain full stack web application features for production use.
  • Build backend services and APIs that support reliable, scalable application functionality.
  • Develop and integrate AI features using LLMs and computer vision techniques.
  • Own technical delivery from problem definition through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes.
  • Review performance data and use findings to improve application quality and user experience.
attributes.desirable:
Desirable (not required)

  • Experience with deploying and operating AI/ML-powered features in production (reliability, latency, and monitoring).
  • Track record of improving system performance using production metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across design, implementation, and iteration.
attributes.benefits:
This is a full-time, 100% remote engagement. You will work directly with the client's small product team and founders on a live product, with real ownership of the application and the opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Upon successful completion of the initial contract, there is potential for long-term collaboration and stable, full-time employment, reflecting our long-term commitment to our team members.

Joining Niuro means becoming part of a global community dedicated to technological excellence and benefiting from strong administrative support infrastructure that enables you to focus on impactful work without distraction.
